command.conditionalvideos.play.invalid: Condition '%s' is not configured or has no videos. Check the spelling and that it has at least one video.
conditionalvideos.notice.header: [ConditionalVideos] %s problem(s) in the conditions (details in the game log):
conditionalvideos.notice.fixed: [ConditionalVideos] The conditions have no problems now.
conditionalvideos.notice.invalid_content: %s has an invalid value (%s); the condition is skipped
conditionalvideos.notice.unknown_file: %s is not a known condition; check the file name
conditionalvideos.notice.unknown_folder: %s is not a known condition folder; check its name
conditionalvideos.notice.missing_namespa: %s needs a namespace folder (for example minecraft/) or an "id" with the full key
conditionalvideos.notice.duplicate: %s defines the same condition as %s; it is ignored
conditionalvideos.notice.area_no_dimensi: %s: a worldPosition needs its dimension; the condition is skipped
conditionalvideos.notice.area_no_corners: %s: a worldPosition needs from and to, each with x and z; the condition is skipped
conditionalvideos.notice.area_one_height: %s: y must be in both from and to, or in neither; the condition is skipped
conditionalvideos.notice.out_of_range: %s: %s %s in video %s is out of range (%s)
conditionalvideos.notice.start_after_nex: %s: startAt %s in video %s is not before its nextAt %s; the video is skipped
conditionalvideos.notice.negative_delay: %s: conditionDelay %s cannot be negative; it plays without delay
conditionalvideos.notice.migration.synta: %s has invalid JSON at line %s, column %s and was not migrated; fix it and restart the game
conditionalvideos.notice.migration.unrea: %s could not be read (%s) and was not migrated; fix it and restart the game
conditionalvideos.notice.migration.not_o: %s does not contain a JSON object and was not migrated; fix it and restart the game
conditionalvideos.notice.migration.faile: %s could not be migrated (%s); it was left untouched and will be retried at the next start
conditionalvideos.notice.migration.ignor: %s was found but %s already exists, so it is ignored. To migrate it again, move or delete the %s folder
conditionalvideos.notice.migration.unrec: %s had %s entry(ies) that do not fit any condition; they were kept as they were in %s
